_comment: Per-provider tool-name rewrite rules applied to agent and command bodies at render time. Source bodies use Claude Code tool names (capitalized). The renderer replaces whole-word occurrences of each `from` token with the provider's equivalent.

claude._comment: Identity — source already uses Claude Code tool names.

opencode._comment: opencode exposes lowercase tool names; the `task` tool spawns subagents; `question` is the quiz tool. Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep/Bash stay lowercase.

codex._comment: Codex uses function-calling tool names: apply_patch (file edits, aliases Edit/Write), spawn_agent (subagent invocation, alias Agent), update_plan (plan/todos), WebSearch (hosted web search). Codex has no structured quiz tool — AskUserQuestion falls back to plain-text question.
codex._post_render_note: Bodies using _plain_text_question_ get a `**NOTE for Codex port**: this question should be asked as plain text; Codex has no structured quiz tool.` appended inline by the renderer.
